{{Freestyle skiing at the 2010 Winter Olympics}}
The women's aerials event in [[freestyle skiing]] at the [[2010 Winter Olympics]] in [[Vancouver]], Canada, took place on the February 20 (qualification) and February 24 (final) at [[Cypress Bowl Ski Area]].

==Results==
===Qualification===
The qualification was held on 20 February at 10:00.<ref>[http://medias2.fis-ski.com/pdf/2010/FS/8035/2010FS8035QRL.pdf Qualification results]</ref>
